name: @dailydraft/engine
description: Lazy-loaded PixiJS scene lifecycle and choreography substrate for DailyDraft

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/pixi.ts --target=browser --outdir=dist --splitting --external pixi.js --external @dailydraft/contracts/pull-rarity --external @dailydraft/contracts/theme-pack && bun build src/react.tsx --target=browser --outdir=dist --splitting --external react --external pixi.js --external @dailydraft/contracts/pull-rarity --external @dailydraft/contracts/theme-pack --banner="'use client';"
